newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Sainsbury l-term, s-term.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Sainsbury l-term, s-term.

text.p: LONDON, Aug 18 - IBCA, the European credit rating agency, has affirmed the long-term and short-term ratings of J Sainsbury plc, the leading UK food retailer, at AA- and A1+ respectively.

This action reflects the continued ratings status of J Sainsbury following the downgrading of the group's long-term rating at the end of November 1996. While published audited results have confirmed the anticipated deterioration in the group's financial condition during 1996/7, IBCA now expects the group to return an improved performance over 1997/8 as a result of stronger sales growth and further market share gains.

J Sainsbury reported significantly lower profits over the year to 8 March 1997, in contrast with the 1996/7 performance of the other three of the UK's big four' food retailers. Increased weakening of financial ratios and coverages denoted by the group's 1996/7 results further underlined its loss of competitive position.
While J Sainsbury experienced market share gains during 1996, its UK supermarket sales densities continued to reduce in real terms.
Its immediate competitor, and the UK grocery market leader, Tesco (AA-/A1+), displayed a noticeably superior operating performance over the period.

By way of response, J Sainsbury has now effected a number of senior management changes and has reorganised its corporate structure, segregating group functions and improving business focus in the core UK supermarket operations. The group has also relaunched its quality-led UK food retailing strategy to differentiate its offer and allow a degree of margin restoration, while reaffirming the historic brand values built up over the group's many years of market leadership.

In the context of current record levels of UK retail spending and recent signs of re-emerging food inflation, the largest food retailers can be expected to continue to enjoy market share growth and reduced pressure on profit margins. IBCA considers that the longer term outlook for J Sainsbury has improved and can now be described as stable.
